hints.title: Greedy Minimum Pair Combination
hints.text: Combining the two smallest sticks first ensures their lengths contribute the least to subsequent summation rounds.

hints.title: Priority Selection Structure
hints.text: Insert all stick lengths into a min-oriented collection that efficiently retrieves the smallest two elements.

hints.title: Iterative Merge
hints.text: Repeatedly remove the two smallest elements, sum them, add the sum to the total cost, and insert the sum back until one stick remains.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def connectSticks(self, sticks: list[int]) -> int:
        heapq.heapify(sticks)
        total_cost = 0
        while len(sticks) > 1:
            first = heapq.heappop(sticks)
            second = heapq.heappop(sticks)
            cost = first + second
            total_cost += cost
            heapq.heappush(sticks, cost)
        return total_cost
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting repeatedly after every stick combination takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A min-oriented priority queue performs logarithmic extractions and insertions, achieving O(N log N) total time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize Huffman coding equivalence and use a min-heap structure.
complexity.notes: If there is only 1 stick, cost to connect is 0.
